properties.name: component.auth.login.enabled
properties.description: Enable login HTTP endpoints and SMS flow.

properties.name: component.auth.login.sms-length
properties.description: SMS verification code length; only 4 or 6.

properties.name: component.auth.login.test.fixed-code
properties.description: Fixed test code for any mobile.

properties.name: component.auth.login.test.mobile-suffix
properties.description: Accept code equal to last sms-length digits of mobile.

properties.name: component.auth.login.test.allow-in-production
properties.description: Acknowledgement flag when test.sms or test.email verification bypass is enabled. Must be true if any test channel is active, otherwise startup fails. Not for real production; use only in local/CI test profiles.
